*The lead and the summary by thesis: 2–3 minutes to read; every row: 29–37 minutes.*

Every test in [experiments](experiments/README.md) by how it came out, the failures first: 66 in all (4 failed; 21 mixed; 2 refused before scoring; 1 decided nothing; 2 partly passed; 3 not rejected; 6 passed; 11 frozen, not run; 3 held; 1 dropped; 12 no frozen prediction), as of 8 November 2026. Each row quotes the test's own folder; the class beside it is a reading of that quote [AI reading], checked against the folder by a second reader, not by a person. A row's thesis is the one method §9 or the test's folder names, and its run date the day the run finished. Experiments retired to [experiments/history](experiments/history/INDEX.md) are not listed.

How to read a verdict, in [method §9](theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#theses)'s words: "A thesis adds no theorem, a refutation removes none, and a failure stays recorded beside the thesis." "A frozen rule fixes how a verdict is scored before the data, not that the rule reads the construct the verdict names." Where they disagree, "the disagreement is reported and the verdict not claimed".
